findings.claim: Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available=false); lineage_support records terminal metadata at score_time 0.99/state_time 1.0 with 14 complete-survival batches, so descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity. The immediate-selection versus descendant-credit comparison cannot be resolved to final affinity benefit and is reported as unavailable.

Ancestral coverage is thin: lineage_support reports 349 nodes with fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 with fewer than 6, so survival enrichment is computed on a survivor-biased subset. Survival enrichment is positive for landmark_00_soft_mass (survival_effects:0, effect_z 0.365, q 0.120) and landmark_10_soft_mass (survival_effects:100, effect_z 0.234, q 0.302), but these are survival_enrichment_z measures, not final affinity benefit.

Immediate endpoint contrasts are strongest and most reproducible for pair_kernel_1.5 (endpoint_effects:9, integrated_z 0.562, q 1.5e-4, positive_batch_fraction 1.0), pair_kernel_2.5 (endpoint_effects:10, 0.631, q 2.2e-5, 1.0), pair_kernel_3.5 (endpoint_effects:11, 0.540, q 9.8e-5, 1.0), and landmark_00_occupancy3 (endpoint_effects:15, 0.545, q 2.4e-4, 1.0); pair_kernel_7.0 (endpoint_effects:13, -0.485, q 1.5e-4, 0.0) and landmark_00_softmin (endpoint_effects:14, -0.481, q 8.1e-4, 0.0) are consistently negative.

Parent-child increment contrasts disagree with endpoint contrasts in direction for several features: landmark_00_softmin increment is negative (increment_effects:14, -4.91, q 0.046) while landmark_00_occupancy3 increment is positive (increment_effects:15, +4.28, q 0.081); pair_kernel_2.5 increment is positive (increment_effects:10, +3.96, q 0.208) but pair_kernel_7.0 increment is negative (increment_effects:13, -3.14, q 0.208); shape_xx and shape_yy increments are negative (increment_effects:3, -3.70; increment_effects:4, -3.85). This disagreement should lower priority of any single-feature direction.

Turnover accounting shows large positive turnover_residual_rate for landmark_00_soft_mass (turnover:2, +4.36, q 0.142), landmark_00_local_cxx (turnover:14, +4.29, q 0.038), landmark_00_local_cyy (turnover:17, +5.05, q 0.033), landmark_01_local_cyy (turnover:47, +6.40, q 0.014), landmark_04_local_cxx (turnover:134, +5.67, q 0.012), landmark_07_local_cxx (turnover:224, +5.08, q 0.012), landmark_08_local_cxx (turnover:254, +5.54, q 0.012), landmark_16_local_cyy (turnover:497, +6.37, q 0.012), landmark_17_local_cxx (turnover:524, +5.24, q 0.012), and landmark_19_local_cxx (turnover:584, +5.30, q 0.012). The residual is an accounting diagnostic including reclassification and parent weighting, not a causal selection effect or atom velocity.

Joint-motion diagnostics are the most reproducible branch-adjusted signals: joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A are negative under both raw_covariance (branch_adjusted:74, -5.2e-5, q 0.038; branch_adjusted:76, -5.0e-5, q 0.044) and adjusted_covariance (branch_adjusted:151, -3.6e-5, q 0.020; branch_adjusted:153, -3.4e-5, q 0.030), with same_sign_batch_fraction 0.93. This indicates coherent joint motion rather than isolated marginal descriptors.

Short-range pair kernels survive branch adjustment: pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5 are positive under adjusted_covariance (branch_adjusted:86, +7.7e-7, q 0.081; branch_adjusted:87, +1.1e-6, q 0.077) and adjusted_correlation (branch_adjusted:240, +0.101, q 0.019; branch_adjusted:241, +0.084, q 0.046), with same_sign_batch_fraction 0.93. Longer-range pair_kernel_7.0 is negative (branch_adjusted:244, -0.050, q 0.129).

Shape_yy is the only shape component with a consistent negative branch-adjusted effect (branch_adjusted:158, raw_correlation -0.103, q 2.6e-3, same_sign 1.0; branch_adjusted:235, adjusted_correlation -0.100, q 0.015, same_sign 1.0), while shape_xx, shape_zz, and off-diagonal shape terms are not consistently signed. This supports treating shape_yy as a distinct coordinate hypothesis rather than averaging shape components.

Continuous contrast functions for landmark_00 features are observed-node linear interpolations over support [0.0,0.49] with extrapolation_allowed=false and polynomial_accepted=false; they show multiple sign changes (e.g., landmark_00_local_dx has 6 sign changes and 9 strong_sign_conflicts; landmark_00_local_cxy has 9 sign changes and 14 strong_sign_conflicts). A constant rule is not supported; a time-conditioned rule would require validated fits, which are not accepted here.

Soft-mass continuous trends are non-monotone across landmarks: landmark_00_soft_mass rises then falls (continuous:0, first_z -0.366, last_z -0.275, 4 sign changes), landmark_01_soft_mass is negative (continuous:10, first_z 0.536, last_z 0.364, 4 sign changes), and landmark_02_soft_mass is negative (continuous:20, first_z -0.269, last_z 0.403, 7 sign changes). No single constant soft-mass rule is supported across the observed support.

Curve fidelity audit selected 24 curves under the rule relative_rmse_le 0.35, strong_sign_conflict_nodes_eq 0, quiet_node_large_fit_fraction_le 0.1, absolute_integrated_z_ge 0.1, batch_direction_fraction_ge 0.857, q_lt 0.05; legendre_runtime_allowed is false for all listed curves. The selected curves are observed-node interpolations, not absolute reward targets, and no extrapolation outside [0.0,0.49] is permitted.

The information audit reports compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A mean 0.081 (CI 0.070-0.092) and top4_teacher_overlap 0.470 (CI 0.427-0.515), indicating only partial teacher agreement. Joint diagnostics show selection_innovation/innovation_native_alignment positive (joint_diagnostics:1, 0.092, q 2.2e-9) but observed_child_score_gain negative (joint_diagnostics:2, -0.036, q 1.8e-7), so innovation alignment does not translate into observed child score gain.

hypotheses.claim: Short-range pair-distance shell density (pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5) is the most reproducible coordinate hypothesis: positive endpoint contrast with positive_batch_fraction 1.0 and positive branch-adjusted covariance/correlation with same_sign_batch_fraction 0.93. A testable intervention would target the pair-distance shell at 1.5-2.5 A; the discriminating failure condition is a null or reversed endpoint contrast when the shell density is perturbed.

Coherent joint internal motion (joint_internal_RMS_A) is a second reproducible hypothesis: negative under both raw and adjusted covariance with same_sign_batch_fraction 0.93-1.0. A testable intervention would reduce joint internal RMS while preserving global pose; the discriminating failure condition is unchanged endpoint contrast despite reduced internal RMS.

Shape_yy is a distinct coordinate hypothesis: negative branch-adjusted correlation with same_sign_batch_fraction 1.0 and negative endpoint contrast (endpoint_effects:4, -0.513, q 1.5e-5, positive_batch_fraction 0.0). The discriminating failure condition is a positive or null shape_yy effect under independent batches.

A time-conditioned coordinate rule is not supported by the supplied evidence: continuous trends are observed-node linear with extrapolation_allowed=false, polynomial_accepted=false, and multiple sign changes; curve_support selected 24 curves but legendre_runtime_allowed is false. The hypothesis remains descriptive until validated fits are supplied.

Large positive turnover_residual_rate for landmark_00_local_cxx, landmark_00_local_cyy, landmark_01_local_cyy, landmark_04_local_cxx, landmark_07_local_cxx, landmark_08_local_cxx, landmark_16_local_cyy, landmark_17_local_cxx, and landmark_19_local_cxx suggests changing cohort composition or reclassification rather than within-path change. This is an accounting diagnostic, not a causal selection effect; a testable intervention would require decoded terminal labels to separate within-path change from composition change.

Selection innovation alignment (joint_diagnostics:11, 0.226, q 2.2e-9) coexists with negative observed child score gain (joint_diagnostics:2, -0.036, q 1.8e-7), so innovation alignment is not evidence of final affinity benefit. The discriminating failure condition is a positive observed child score gain under independent batches.

limitations: Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable; descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity.
Turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling.
Adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence; region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.
Curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient; no time bins or outside-window analysis.
Static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts, not actual final structures.
All weak and null scalar effects retained; current study outcomes are withheld from design roles.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters; no temperature edit is proposed or compiled.
The executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; moment effects are diagnostic only.
